scope: Loaded only from private .runtime/documents/identity.json; bootstrap checks any existing document store before provisioning missing identity. No scope/DSN/SQL accepted in bridge frames.
reply: {protocol,requestId,status,data}; successful dispatch outer status OK, inspect data.status. receipt/finalize data.responseBase64 is exact stored original HTTP envelope bytes. Reads return headRevision/requestedRevision/artifact/provenance.
finalization: COMMITTED stale base returns STALE_REVISION+acceptedRevision and retains nonce/reservation; coordinator builds REJECTED outcome then finalizes. NonCREATE REJECTED outcome.data.acceptedRevision must equal locked head, otherwise same STALE_REVISION loop. Policy mismatch returns REVALIDATE without terminal receipt. Existing receipt is returned before new frame/artifact/outcome validation.
recovery: recover requires current nonce and same live supervisor PID/start ticks. Explicit worker PID/start ticks must be dead, or null with trusted noWorkerStarted=true. It rotates nonce and retains all reservations; stale old nonce cannot finalize. admit takeover for a different supervisor only after old PID/start identity verifiably dead. No time expiry. Coordinator must enforce its shared validation permit and proof provenance.
identity: ownerStartTicks Linux /proc/<supervisorPID>/stat field22, exact string; CLI requires admit/recover ownerPid equal its actual getppid. PID reuse never proves old owner alive.
sql: Only allow_retrieval.sql_connections.connect; existing allow-app/allow-migration tags and fixed existing GUC keys. No direct backend fallback.
known_rollback: Conservative whitelist: SQLSTATE classes22,23,25,42 and exact40001/40P01. All class08,08007,40003 and other unlisted errors are UNKNOWN_COMMIT_OUTCOME.
recoverUnstarted: Only coordinator retaining exact request proof recorded BEFORE a lost admission call, while holding shared permit and before any worker start, may send noWorkerStarted=true with same actual supervisorPID/start. Store checks exact active identity and rotates nonce under locks. Ordinary samePID admission remains IN_PROGRESS. Absent admission returns ABSENT so coordinator may admit fresh.
route: Document route is exact literal server:UUID or canonical uppercase server%3AUUID segment, never normalized. Changed route encoding under same key conflicts; lowercase escapes/query/double encoding reject.
freshness: Before final append, under workspace/document locks scan bounded authorized document module definitions. BLOCK definitions equal rawexisting IDs (same historical kind) plus injective exact draft-definition remapping; fresh mapping values disjoint full history. SOURCE generated definitions all disjoint full history. HISTORY_COPY exact content revalidation remains separate. Failure precedes mutation/receipt; no ID side table.
recovery_null_start: Narrow implementation of frozen trusted verified-old-owned-process-reaping predicate: supervisor must establish its owned Process has been reaped before workerPid nonnull/workerStartTicks null/noWorkerStarted=false. Store additionally requires identity.process_start(workerPid) is None. Never compare alive(pid,None); any live/reused process with observable start ticks rejects. Exact owner supervisor/start, current nonce and exact original intent remain required. This is not expiry or a new authority.
